title: Electrifiable
summary: ELEC'TRIFIABLE, adjective [from electrify.] Capable of receiving electricity, or of being charged with it; that may become electric. 1. Capable of receiving and transmitting the electrical fluid.

inlines.v: ELEC'TRIFIABLE, adjective [from electrify.] Capable of receiving electricity, or of being charged with it; that may become electric. 1. Capable of receiving and transmitting the electrical fluid.
